title: adapter-tester.config.json
description: Configuration for @recursica/adapter-tester. All fields are optional — an adapter repo with a normal `storybook` npm script needs no config file at all.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete, e.g. "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/borderux/recursica/main/packages/adapter-tester/src/adapter-tester.schema.json".

name.description: Label for this project's own target. Defaults to the unscoped name in this project's package.json (e.g. "@recursica/some-adapter" -> "some-adapter").

port.description: Port the target's Storybook is served on. Auto-detected from this project's own `scripts.storybook` (a `-p <port>`/`--port <port>` flag) when omitted, falling back to Storybook's own default of 6006.

command.description: Command that boots the target's Storybook. Defaults to `npm run storybook`.

cwd.description: Directory the command runs in, relative to the config file. Defaults to ".".

oneOf.description: Default mode: boots a throwaway harness that installs the published @recursica/mantine-adapter from npm — no monorepo checkout required.

port.description: Port the throwaway harness's Storybook is served on. Defaults to 6011.

mantineAdapterVersion.description: npm version/tag of @recursica/mantine-adapter to install in the harness. Defaults to `latest`.

storybookTemplateVersion.description: npm version/tag of @recursica/storybook-template to install in the harness. Defaults to `latest`.

oneOf.description: Non-standard mode: points at an already-addressable Storybook — e.g. a sibling workspace package's own Storybook inside this monorepo.

name.description: Label for the source-of-truth target. Defaults to "Mantine".

port.description: Port the source-of-truth Storybook is served on.

command.description: Command that boots the source-of-truth Storybook. Defaults to `npm run storybook`.

cwd.description: Directory the command runs in, relative to the config file. Defaults to ".".

isSourceOfTruthAdapter.description: True only for the source-of-truth adapter's own config (mantine-adapter). Skips `sourceOfTruth` entirely — there's nothing above it to diverge from — and runs the own-drift golden check standalone, against just this project's own Storybook. Defaults to false.

diffThresholdPixels.description: Global visual diff threshold, in mismatched pixels, before a story is considered a failure. Defaults to 3500. AI agents must not modify this field — see AGENT.md.

threshold.description: Diff threshold override for matching stories, in mismatched pixels. Overrides `diffThresholdPixels`.

exclude.description: Skip matching stories entirely — no own-drift check, no divergence check, no golden captured. For stories that don't have a cross-adapter counterpart; use `excludeTitlePrefixes` to drop a whole title instead.

stories.description: Per-story overrides, keyed by story id prefix (a story matches if its id equals the key or starts with it). When more than one key matches a story, the longest (most specific) key wins.

excludeTitlePrefixes.description: Storybook title prefixes to exclude from comparison, in addition to the built-in denylist (`Theme/*`, `Tokens/*`, `Introduction`).
